Its in the middle of a long hallway that leads to four hockey arenas and is secluded from the more popular areas of the Y such as the gym. it’s summer, no people except the staff of the Y that aren’t near where my work is. Days are slow therefore I’m booked to work alone. Last saturday I had a shift, and no one was there except the casual gym nuts that ordering from my store. One man, mid 30s was one of my customers that day. I didn’t make much of it at first, he ordered some food from me and then that was that, a normal customer transaction. Once home, my dad told me that everytime the guy passed by he would give him the dirty look while we were talking to the YMCA staff. I now feel like an asshole if this were to be true, but doesn’t stop the fact that if he really was just playing a game, the next time he’s going to do it he’ll face be kicked out of the YMCA. AITA?
